descriptions.needs_source: Entities with fewer than two references, or a structured fact whose source is missing (the build already fails on the latter).
descriptions.needs_medical_review: Entities whose review status is before clinical review.
descriptions.potential_duplicate: Two pages, or a catalogued concept and a page, with the same normalised name.
descriptions.possible_synonym_error: An alias that is also the name or alias of another entity of the same kind (a same-class medicine or a sub-test presented as 'also known as').
descriptions.possible_brand_mapping_error: A brand name listed under more than one ingredient, or an alias that looks like a brand but is not in the brands table.
descriptions.possible_active_ingredient_error: A product ingredient given as free text although a medication page with that name exists.
descriptions.class_mapping_conflict: A medicine whose drugClass differs from the class that lists it as a member, or an alias that names a class.
descriptions.interaction_data_conflict: Interaction records left at needs-review because their sources disagree.
descriptions.test_reference_range_risk: A test whose text quotes numeric cut-offs without a sourced, jurisdiction-tagged threshold record.
descriptions.regulatory_status_conflict: Two regulatory entries for the same jurisdiction with different statuses and no note explaining why.
descriptions.deprecated_terminology: Terminology mappings flagged deprecated or discouraged by the terminology release.
descriptions.sparse_public_page: Indexable pages with little body text or a single reference.
descriptions.coverage_gap: Catalogued test concepts and taxonomy classes that have no public page yet, by category (not thin pages: they are database-only until written).
